limits: A source manifest is file identity evidence. Equal captured hashes do not prove equality of paths omitted from that manifest, packages, process environments, external models or the final installer.

The 110-file runtime manifests cover agent (65), localpilot_api (7), localpilot_service (37), and scripts/qualify_openai_agent.py (1). They do not individually capture Desktop, Companion, Suite, Computer/plugin modules or every specialized qualification/benchmark harness.

Full snapshot manifests retain hashes for source, tests, docs and historical evidence. Missing paths in the final source-only commit are listed explicitly and are all documentation/evidence, not runtime code.
Snapshot and final-only test/harness additions are recorded by hash; tests and evidence are not reclassified as production changes.
No final result, score, duration completion or process-state claim was inferred from the active soak or ITBench run. Their source attribution remains the earlier frozen snapshots.

Final package build identity is coordinator-supplied metadata in this source-only audit. Native profile E is RUNNING, not PASS; a later UI result cannot rewrite source identity of earlier model tasks.
